hero_description: Flexible interior and exterior valeting carried out at your home or workplace, with services tailored around what your vehicle actually needs.
intro_paragraph_1: Not every vehicle needs the same treatment. Choose an interior service, an exterior service or combine the two depending on where your car needs the most attention.
intro_paragraph_2: ACAMADI uses the appropriate products, tools and cleaning methods for the different surfaces throughout your vehicle.

prices.label: Basic Interior
prices.description: A straightforward interior reset for cars that need regular cleaning rather than a deep detail.

prices.label: Steam Interior
prices.description: A more detailed interior service using steam alongside the standard interior cleaning process.

prices.label: Wash n Go
prices.description: A proper maintenance wash for keeping the exterior of your vehicle clean without unnecessary extras.

prices.label: Shine
prices.description: A more complete exterior valet with additional wheel cleaning, tar removal and protection.

prices.label: This is a Test Item
prices.description: Just a test to see how adding in another service option would look.
